authority: Author-side explanation and verification record only. This file is not an independent review, acceptance, application, seal, freeze, demonstration, or product qualification.
purpose: Record how the R1 v1.5 successor selects the exact Rust pure-core realization required by the independently passing Phase 3 v4 preparation without reopening the accepted v1 one-shot/pure-core architecture.
selfHashRule: This adjudication cannot embed the SHA-256 of its own complete bytes without a self-reference. The exact file hash is captured externally in the handoff after this file is stable; the two review subjects above are pinned here exactly.
basisReadRule: The author read every frozen-basis input completely before authoring the successor. D9 v1.13 and fact-plane v1 were additionally hash-pinned and their exact owned vocabulary subtrees were recomputed by the checker; neither is accepted or applied here.

dispositions.decision: One public pure-core entry point: evaluate(stageInput: &SealedStageInput, deps: &CoreDeps, attempt: &AttemptMetadata) -> CoreCompletion.
dispositions.antiFork: No by-value, mutable, async, streaming, callback, trait-object, resident, or lifetime-parameterized alternate signature. Inputs are shared immutable borrows; the completion is transitively owned.

dispositions.decision: AttemptMetadata is the exact closed record {executionId}. It is host-allocated/injected, never minted in core, and excluded from evidence identity.
dispositions.negativeClosure: RequestId and every unknown or nested authority field reject.

dispositions.decision: CoreDeps is the exact immutable data-only record {rules, policy, budgetLimits}; every nested type, array ordering, uniqueness rule, integer bound, and unknown-field behavior is closed.
dispositions.removedLegacyHandles: v1.4 resourceMeter and diagnostics handles are replaced by call-local counters and an owned bounded buffer; sinks, callbacks, ports, schedulers, interior mutability, mutexes, atomics, service locators, and ambient handles are forbidden.

dispositions.decision: Rule and policy counters initialize from u64 limits, charge exactly one before each unit, stop at the first failed charge without decrement, never wrap/saturate, and return exact usage on every completion.
dispositions.coverageRule: The direct semantic effect is exactly the failed coverageKey becoming budget-exhausted. The incomplete variant, deficiency, and indeterminate policy outcome are deterministic consequences of that Coverage.

dispositions.decision: The call-local buffer retains the first capacity records in emission order, assigns contiguous attempted-emission ordinals, drops every later record, and reports an exact u128 dropped count. Capacity zero is the valid no-op form.
dispositions.neutrality: Diagnostics, diagnostic capacity, and budget-usage bookkeeping are excluded from the evidence projection and cannot alter findings, Coverage, or policy outcome.

dispositions.decision: The v1.4 completed/incomplete/cancelled/faulted union and all semantic fields are preserved. diagnosticsRef is replaced by owned DiagnosticsData and exact BudgetUsage is added to every closed variant.
dispositions.ownership: Cancellation and fault are values, not exceptions, and both retain their owned diagnostic/budget extras. No completion can carry RunId, SealedRun, HostTermination, code, exit, callback, or borrow.

dispositions.decision: faulted carries only the exact normalized cause enum owned as inert data by opensip-d9-values. opensip-d9 and the one-shot host remain the sole derivation/finalization owners.
dispositions.nonPromotion: The checker pins/recomputes D9 v1.13 cause values because frozen Phase 3 v4 names that candidate. This R1 candidate does not accept or apply D9 v1.13.

dispositions.decision: v1 remains exactly a one-shot Rust orchestration host plus pure data-only evaluation core.
dispositions.park: Resident/autostart/default/daemon/multi-project host modes remain prohibited in v1 and measurement-gated behind explicit later scope change and LN-10 evidence.

dispositions.decision: Dependency, recursive import/call, and compiled binary/link closure are specified across Cargo classes, targets, FFI, dynamic loading, symbols, build products, and collaborator shapes.
dispositions.honestLimit: They are IMPLEMENTABLE_UNEXECUTED and establish bounded static evidence only. Runtime denial remains NOT DISCHARGED until a restricted runtime and ARCH.PROBE-CONTRACT exist; untrusted imperative rules remain excluded.

dispositions.decision: The candidate selects Phase 3 v4 rustR1ApplicationMapping exactly and cross-checks the opensip-core six-class dependency row. It is a possible future sourceManifest for port 4 only after different-author independent review and explicit acceptance/application.
dispositions.nonAuthority: The preliminary Phase 3 v4 PASS is preparation evidence, not architecture freeze or implementation authorization.

checkerConstruction.pycPolicy: No repository checker is imported. The retained predecessor checker is hash-pinned/read-only; therefore .pyc cannot enter the v1.5 oracle. Any future imported checker must be authenticated as source bytes then compiled/executed from that buffer.
normalOracle: exact source hashes and frozen Phase 3 preliminary PASS posture
recursive total closed-type validation with exact JSON integer semantics
all adversarial controls through constructed negative probes
checkerConstruction.selftestPolicy: A dirty base refuses. Mutation failure-to-apply, no-op, duplicate id, skipped row, unexpected finding code, or accepted mutation is an escape. Raw duplicate/nonfinite/float parser probes and hostile totality shapes are separate from object mutations.

verification.interpretation: These green author-side runs establish only what their oracles inspect. They are not independent evidence and do not change any acceptance/application status.

residuals.text: No Rust product code exists, so no runtime parity, ownership, counter, diagnostics, static closure, or binary closure property is demonstrated.
No restricted runtime denies ambient capability attempts. Static absence is not runtime confinement.
Resident-host value and topology remain unmeasured and excluded.
D9 v1.13 supplies the exact Phase 3 normalized cause vocabulary but remains candidate-only in the frozen Phase 3 preparation.

A different author must freeze both subject hashes, independently reconstruct the schema/counter/diagnostic/identity/Phase 3 joins, run new falsifiers, and return an exact-byte verdict before acceptance.
